opportunities.title: Main Grants

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK; projects must be led by organisations with a UK host; individuals must have formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) for research addressing priority questions from the Foundation's Strategic Review.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organisations, especially from racially minoritised communities; encourages partnership applications.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity in the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes and challenges, with grants ranging £15,000‑£500,000.
